g.text: Rastok M0 — bird's-eye module overview (companion to 05, no members)
node — shared graph and execution vocabulary
envelope — data and metadata carried through the graph
diagnostics — structured diagnostics shared across phases
cel — isolated CEL compilation and evaluation domain
stdlib — declarative contracts for standard capabilities
boundary — contracts with the external world
journal — durable causal history and recovery model
lab — scenario, simulation, and conformance tooling
cli — binary assembly and user-facing commands
absence or declared class of effect
raw, Avro, or Arrow IPC encoding
stable diagnostic identity and structured details
parse, resolve, check, plan, run, replay, or simulation
names and types visible to an expression
bridge exposing Rastok state to CEL
valid plan, semantic hash, and warnings
compiled graph shipped to runtime hosts
guest identity, ABI, and purity contract
starts external calls and supplies responses
supplies one due event at a time
scheduler-owned event with a logical date
pure execution engine shared by run and simulation
One line per type ; no fields, no methods, no type-level arrows.
ownership edges, and build artifacts are deliberately not shown.
Base modules `node`, `envelope`, `diagnostics` are used by every
module except `cel` — those arrows are omitted.
«next» = APIs kept ready, not built in M0 ;
